encode_text_with_sentencepiece: encode a string into sentencepiece BPE tokens using the SentencepieceBPE encode method
decode_sentencepiece_tokens: decode sentencepiece BPE token strings back into readable text using the decode method
check_beginning_of_word: check if a sentencepiece token is the beginning of a word using is_beginning_of_word
review_sentencepiece_bpe_class: review the SentencepieceBPE class and its encode, decode, and is_beginning_of_word methods
add_sentencepiece_args: add the sentencepiece-model argument to an argparse parser using SentencepieceBPE add_args
